headline: On November 16, 1973: Skylab 4 launched with three astronauts
captionCards: Set record for longest crewed spaceflight at the time
instagramCaption:
Skylab 4 launched from Cape Canaveral, Florida.

NASA sent three astronauts on an 84-day mission aboard the U.S.'s first space station.
They joined two prior crews who had occupied Skylab for about 24 weeks between May 1973 and February 1974.
Skylab 4 set a record for longest crewed spaceflight at the time.
It paved the way for future long-duration space missions and station operations.
